description: Predetermined expected results for the pod's shared fixtures (Phase 2 section 4.2). Written by hand before running any implementation; never derived from one. 'components' and 'acceptance_criteria' are the lists the tester counts for component and system coverage; the component list is our proposal until the pod specification adopts one.

components.request-intake: Accepts and validates a product/release request (POST /bundles; REQ-01)
components.status-retrieval: Looks up a bundle by id and returns its state (GET /bundles/{bundle_id}; REQ-04)
components.artifact-retrieval: Retrieves the artifacts of the requested release from the configured source (REQ-02, REQ-04)
components.classification: Assigns PRESENT / MISSING / INVALID / INACCESSIBLE to each category (REQ-03, REQ-06)
components.manifest-generation: Builds the manifest and terminal bundle status (REQ-05)
components.source-failure-handling: Reports a failed external source while keeping other results (REQ-07)

complete.purpose: Every category has a valid Markdown artifact.

missing.purpose: Exactly one category (Test Logs) has no artifact.

invalid.purpose: The SBOM artifact exists but is empty.

unknown.purpose: No release with this identifier exists in any source.
